root_cause_analysis.symptom: Markdown tables with wide content overflow the message card's right edge (visible bleed)
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: messageContent flex item is missing minWidth:0, so flexbox does not allow it to shrink below its content width. agentMessageContainer is missing maxWidth:'100%' and overflow:'hidden', so it does not bound the table's display width. Even though the table wrapper in MarkdownView.tsx has overflowX:'auto', the effect is nullified when the ancestor container has no width constraint.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: a59b3795 — fix: table font mismatch and mobile overflow on web (2026-03-25, /root/happy)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The dev worktree was branched from a base that predated commit a59b3795. The MarkdownView.tsx portion was backported but the MessageView.tsx portion was not.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: In CSS/React Native flexbox, a flex item with flex:1 but without minWidth:0 has an implicit minimum size equal to its content. This means the item can grow past the parent bounds even when the parent has overflow constraints. Without minWidth:0 on messageContent, the table can force its parent wider than the screen.
